purpose: Let proven specialist capabilities recombine into new agents and self-organising venture cells while keeping authority bounded and evidence traceable.

structuralGrowth.platformLimitStrategy: When one native parent reaches the platform child limit, create or select an intermediate cell lead and continue the lineage through another branch. Never treat a platform fan-out limit as a total population limit.
antiBloat: reuse an existing capable agent before spawning a redundant clone
require evidence of expected capability gain

stages.question: What economically and legally accessible resource is proven to exist?
What usable raw material or intermediate can be proven to come from that resource?
Which current or emerging world need makes this material strategically valuable?
Which product converts the material and need into the strongest opportunity?
What design and production path can create the product better than alternatives?
What route delivers the product to the user with the strongest adoption and economics?
What does real-world response prove or falsify about the full chain?

valueChainEcology.chainSelection: Compete full compatible chains as well as individual agents. The best individual specialists do not automatically form the best chain.

rules: No single aggregate score may erase a safety, evidence, or truthfulness failure.
A champion must pass repeated comparable trials, not one lucky answer.
Maintain a Pareto frontier when candidates trade quality, latency and cost.
Select the champion for the current niche and project context, not a universal permanent winner.
A reigning lead may be replaced by a descendant after independent repeated superiority evidence.

breeding.parentSelection: Select proven complementary traits, not merely the highest overall scores.
breeding.crossover: Choose trait-level inheritance from each parent and preserve immutable Factory genes separately.
breeding.mutation: Generate bounded alternative strategies only when an explicit hypothesis predicts a measurable gain.
breeding.offspringAdmission: Research -> Evidence -> Build -> Audit -> SPAWN -> internal publish -> native attach -> train -> evaluate -> retain/reject/quarantine.

championToCell.rule: When a descendant repeatedly wins an economically meaningful domain and its workload is persistent, it may become a new domain lead and form a dedicated cell.

firstCrossCellBirth.name: AI Factory Handoff Coordinator G3
firstCrossCellBirth.meaning: First durable proof that multiple functional lineages can jointly research, evidence-check, design and audit a child before it is spawned.
